title: the librarian names its host through the system device's host tool
intention: The librarian names its host through the system device's host tool: cairn/devices/librarian/shim.py:77 read the host from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host and nowhere else, so this component names its box on every OS.
why: Akien, 2026-11-21, relayed by akiendelllinux_cc_orchestrator: "hostname should come from the system device." Folded into outline 6.6.3.7 and 2.3.7.1.5 (branch akiendelllinux/host-door-outline, 97b4ce0b7). Measured 2026-11-21: cairn/devices/librarian/shim.py:77 (chat_url: host == platform.node()) spell the host by hand, so a box with no os.uname (Windows) or a nodename the roster does not spell breaks here. Child of spanning ticket a577fd03e307 (one door names the host). Ticket 5ccc7f05c932 (READY c9824d056 on branch akiendelllinux/5ccc-host-door) builds the door, cairn/devices/system_rackmount/tools/host/host.py; this build starts after it lands on main, because the tool does not exist on main before then.
traces_to: Outline 6.6.3.7 (the hostname comes from the system device); outline 2.3.7.1.5 (the system device's host tool is one of the client tools a device publishes, the named exception to 2.3.7; a CC by-line builds, 0.4.1); outline 17.26.1 (a published client tool lives with its device); RULE 1 (the system device's public interface is the tool it publishes); Law 1 (one answer, not N re-derivations of it).
how: shim.py:77 compares the short lowercased CAIRN_HOME_HOST (`host.split('.')[0].lower()`) to a lazy host_name() from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host, the comparison bus/server.py:1057 already makes. This widens a match: a CAIRN_HOME_HOST spelled with capitals or a domain now reads as this box, as it does for the bus.

clauses.claim: an AST scan of cairn/devices/librarian/shim.py finds no call to os.uname, platform.node, platform.uname or socket.gethostname, and every host name those files read comes from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host.host_name

with os.uname deleted from the os module, CAIRN_WEB_SERVER_PORT unset and CAIRN_HOME_HOST set in-process, chat_url() starts 'http://127.0.0.1' for host_name().upper() + '.lan' and starts 'http://testing-lib-not-this-box' for 'testing-lib-not-this-box'

decisions.text: D1: each site reads the host from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host. shim.py:77 compares the short lowercased CAIRN_HOME_HOST (`host.split('.')[0].lower()`) to a lazy host_name() from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host, the comparison bus/server.py:1057 already makes. This widens a match: a CAIRN_HOME_HOST spelled with capitals or a domain now reads as this box, as it does for the bus.

D2: the red-first proof cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_the_librarian_names_its_host_through_the_system_device.py, one tooth per clause, PROVES keyed to this ticket; it deletes os.uname for each call and restores it in finally, and reads no live ~/.cairn.

out: every other component's host sites (siblings under a577fd03e307)
OS-family checks (platform.system, sys.platform, os.name): outline 6.6.3.7 claims the hostname only

measured.how: grep -rnE 'os\.uname\(\)|platform\.node\(\)|socket\.gethostname\(\)|platform\.uname\(\)' over cairn/ skills/ bin/ on branch akiendelllinux/5ccc-host-door (c9824d056)

measured.saw: clause 2 reds against the unbuilt code only by its widened match (CAIRN_HOME_HOST with capitals and a domain); its os.uname half cannot red on Linux, because platform.node() falls back to socket.gethostname() there, so that half is a hollow green on this box
measured.how: the new proof run in this ticket's worktree with the code file put back to HEAD's bytes, bin/cairn test --exec, akiendelllinux (akiendelllinux_cc_0)

builder_notes: BEFORE PROVED: akiendell_cc_0 runs this ticket's proof natively on Windows (os.uname absent there) once it is relaunched, and records that verdict on this ticket; it is clause 2's real measurement (orchestrator, 2026-11-21)
